title: nbn FTTP or HFC 500/50 $69.99/M for 6-Months Then $79.99/M for 18-Months (Existing Exetel & Superloop Customers Only) @ Arctel
body:
Deal: nbn FTTP or HFC 500/50 $69.99/M for 6-Months Then $79.99/M for 18-Months (Existing Exetel & Superloop Customers Only) @ Arctel

[sprof] Hmm not heard great stories with these guys
Be careful they might just delete your account with a system update too https://whrl.pl/RgXxRL
[Team Triforce] @sprof - Definitely some teething issues in 2025, but we are still here without thousands of customers on board!
Powered by the Superloop network, here’s your chance to save & get the same experience!
[Viospeed] Amaysim are doing 1000/100 plans right now for that price:
https://www.amaysim.com.au/home-internet/nbn
[Team Triforce] Moves to $90, unless bundled with a SIM. Also, can’t compare the Optus network to Superloop’s! It’s the fastest NBN network in the country!
[Viospeed] Yeah and I will be switching after the 6 months promo to another ISP just like I've been doing the last few years.
Getting 550mbps download on a 500/50 plan during peak times so I dont think Superloop will be faster:
https://www.speedtest.net/result/19690860474
[Viospeed] @philart: Yeah I got a good deal, paying $50 per month for this plan during a promo which comes with a sticky IP.
[AppleSmack] Been with Arctel for over a month now, and all i can say is they went above and beyond with a router reception issue due to my house internals, and then had an issue with horrible speeds at midnight one night and i was surprised to get a response to my email 5 minutes later, spent about 20 mins troubleshooting and ended up being a bad cable on my end, not sure anyone else would be offering support at midnight, probably dont sleep like me :p.
No complaints here, great consistent speeds.
[Team Triforce] Thanks for the support @AppleSmack, we definitely don’t always get it right but the team is working hard to keep our customers happy!
[AppleSmack] I wouldnt stress, whether your Arctel, Telstra, Optus, Starlink, there are always going to be haters
[Team Triforce] Here to please mate, don’t want to follow the others!
[cray] Currently on my last week with superloop and about to churn to Carbon Comms on the 500/50 plan. HFC in Perth. Should I go with these guys instead?
[AppleSmack] Give em a crack, see what you think, tell them i sent ya HAHAHAHA ;)
[cray] Just read some old posts from these guys, not really convinced
[AppleSmack] Each to their own, ive been with Launtel, ABB and Exetel, I would not go back to any of them. So far so good with Arctel and speed is above whats on offer and support has been mint.
[cray] @AppleSmack: Send me your referral id mate
[Team Triforce] @cray: No referral program as yet (in the works) but I’m going to throw @AppleSmack a $50 voucher with our online store (Hub by Triforce)!
Love the community engagement! Shoot me your order ID once signed up @cray & I will look after our mate.
[cray] @Team Triforce: 123014 cheers and good on ya for looking out for AppleSmack
[Team Triforce] @cray: Got ya, thanks for signing up & let me know if you need any assistance.
[AppleSmack] @cray: @cray See, what other provider would go above and beyond??? I can answer that, NO ONE.
@Team Triforce look out for their customers
[AppleSmack] @Team Triforce: You guys rock, thank you so much :)
[Team Triforce] @AppleSmack: Check your DM’s, code has been delivered! ❤️
[Team Triforce] Don’t let yesterday cost you tomorrow! If you’re referred by @AppleSmack you can sign up, DM me your order ID # & I will ensure you’re treated like a VIP!
[cray] This is reassuring as carbon don't have that. Can I future date the start? I might need static as well, I'm assuming I can add this anytime?
[Team Triforce] Sure can mate, you have 30 days from signing up to activate & a static IP can be added at anytime!
[philart] @ Store Rep, We are with Exetel/Superloop with a Fixed IP and no CGNAT, is that what you're offering?
[Team Triforce] We can provide a static IP, but unfortunately it’s $5 p/Month.
[philart] @ Store Rep, it's what we pay now, is that without CGNAT? so $74.99 rising to $84.99.
[Team Triforce] So if you moved over from SL/Exetel, you would be paying $69.99 (down from $79.99) for 6-Months, then $79.99 for a further 18-Months!
It’s widely expected certain providers may be increasing prices in 2027, or charging $ to lock in at a price of $95 today!
Add on the $5 for a free static IP, you’re still winning with the 24-Month price lock, no contract term for you!
[philart] @Team Triforce: I understand but won't consider it unless you answer my CGNAT question. Thanks.
[Team Triforce] @philart: @philart - Sorry, by default we use CG-NAT! Unfortunately we are very tight on IPV4 allocations, we are currently working with APNIC to get access to more.
Each service is dual stacked IPV4/6, with a static IPV6 address by default.
[Poimandres] I was waiting for a deal to jump on from Super Loop. There current offerings are atrocious. I signed up for this. I just jumped from 50 to 500 and will be saving $20 a month for the first 6 months, then $10 a month after that.
[Team Triforce] That’s it mate, prices are going up everywhere & we are trying to shake the pricing up a little.
Completely open to the fact we had some challenges in the start, occasionally the support team is a little inundated… but it’s growing, takes time to keep training new staff.
We have been in the business for years, nothing new here, so the ones that give us a try & come over, will hopefully enjoy it.
Plus you’ve always got me here to help out!
Cheers,
Hus
[Fanzao] do I have to stay 24 months with thia deal?
[Team Triforce] Can leave anytime, just at the end of the month!
[TheTwin] How does the porting work with Superloop, as you're supposed to give them 30 days notice of cancelling their service? (which is insane, obviously)
[Team Triforce] Unfortunately we can’t intervene in the notice period. With us, you can leave before the new month, at any time (assuming you don’t have a modem on your plan!)
[appyausi] As I heard from Superloop customer service recently, they also acknowledge that issue; I do not know when, but they said the 30-day policy may be removed in the future.
[appyausi] Are customer support, billing, and all technical fault management handled by Superloop if I port, as I have always had good experiences with their support team?
[Team Triforce] @appyausi - We have our own technical engineering team based here in Australia & a support team between here & Manila.
We are a subsidiary of an established enterprise network provider in Australia! Triforce Australia
All technical matters, billing & support are handled by our team, Superloop is one of the network providers we use to deliver NBN services 👍🏽
[Whalesaurus] Would staying for the promo period (24 months) mean that you would be eligible for the "free" eero 7?
[Team Triforce] Yep, router is free if you stay on for 24-Months 👍🏽
[Whalesaurus] Oh nvm I went though the motions and see how it works. The answer should be yes for those wondering
[Lolitsjoel] So if we sign up this weekend, and then give Superloop their silly 30day cancellation it’s still valid at the time of cancellation?
[Team Triforce] Yep, 100% is. You have 30 days from when you signup, but if you need an extra 1-2 days… our team will manually update your provision date for you :)
[MEasI] Why the website shows $67.99 per month for 6 month and them 84.99 for me?
[Team Triforce] If you look at the 24M deal, for 500/50 & have an existing Exetel/SL service… you will get the additional discount code 👍🏽
[Believ3r] I can’t find my avc id on my superloop bill / invoice ?
[Team Triforce] Should be on there, if you don’t submit it on the signup form, you’re automatically out of the automatic provisions :(
It should be on the third page of your invoice, in the blue box… don’t ask how I know 😎
[Believ3r] Ok found it signed up to 1000mbit down 100up. I was charged $99 instantly but I’m still with superloop which my next billing periods is 23sep. Does this mean you guys will charge me again in another month while I’m still within the 30 day period with superloop?
[Team Triforce] Nope, so we take a month upfront. This will apply to the 23/09 - 23/10. In October, you’ll be charged for 24/10-31/10 & then a full month on the 1/11.
Hope that makes sense? The pro-rata is done automatically 👍🏽
[moorey] Am with SL opticomm at the moment. Will be moving house at the end of the month and the house is NBN FTTP, would (could) this promo apply?
[Team Triforce] Would we… yes? Could we… sure! Drop me a DM, will have to be a special code & we might get something from you to make sure you’re really on SL!
Otherwise we might open up the gates 😎
Thanks for asking & looking forward to having you sign up!
[BartholemewH] Does arctel notify Exetel/Superloop that we're shitcanning their service? I know they try to stick you for a month notice.
[Team Triforce] If you provide your AVC ID, we definitely let them
Know you’re leaving!
[AdelaideDeals] The arctel is bunch of unprofessional people. Completely ridiculous experience and not worth it even half of the price. Find better providers.
[Team Triforce] @AdelaideDeals - Sorry if you had a bad experience, definitely not our internet toon but can happen :/
